# Emily Tillett in Bloomberg on liquidations in the Chinese real estate market


- Bankruptcy & insolvency


July 30, 2024


-
-
-
-


Emily Tillett speaks with Bloomberg about liquidation cases in China’s real estate sector.


Tillett is quoted: "'One of the key aspects of our underwriting process is reviewing enforceability – we must be confident that if the case is successful, payment will be made... China enforcement has significant risk and is complex and time consuming.'"


[Click here to read the full article.](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-07-29/liquidators-struggle-to-recover-cash-from-china-s-broke-builders)
